entries.subject: JWST observations of ALTAIR (programmes 4534, 8507)
entries.finding: JWST observed ALTAIR in programmes 4534, 8507 (NIRCam coronagraphy), a coronagraphic image of its surroundings. The star itself is not resolved and is masked or saturated, so these give no stellar surface. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
